# NoteWise Documentation Map for LLM Retrieval

Project: NoteWise
Description: Convert YouTube videos and playlists into AI-powered Markdown study notes from your terminal.
Primary Entry: https://notewise.click/docs

## Overview

NoteWise is a Python CLI application (Python 3.10+) that uses LLM APIs to generate study notes from YouTube content. It supports multiple providers via LiteLLM including Gemini (default), OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, xAI, Mistral, Cohere, and DeepSeek.

## Behavioral Truths (Avoid Common Mistakes)

### Output File Naming
- Standard video: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/<sanitized_title>.md`
- Quiz export: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/<sanitized_title>_quiz.md`
- Transcript export: `<OUTPUT_DIR>/<sanitized_title>_transcript.txt` or `.json`
- Chapter-aware (duration > 1 hour with chapters): `<OUTPUT_DIR>/<title>/01_<chapter>.md`, `02_<chapter>.md`, etc.

### Configuration
- Config file: `~/.notewise/config.env`
- Override location: `NOTEWISE_HOME` environment variable
- Priority: code defaults < config.env < environment variables < CLI flags

### Cache Behavior
- `cache --clear` removes database records ONLY
- Does NOT delete generated note files on disk

### YouTube
- Private/age-gated videos require `--cookie-file`
- Rate limit: `YOUTUBE_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` (default: 10)

## Supported LLM Providers

| Provider | Config Key | Default Model |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Google Gemini | GEMINI_API_KEY | gemini/gemini-2.5-flash |
| OpenAI | OPENAI_API_KEY | openai/gpt-4o |
| Anthropic | ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 |
| Groq | GROQ_API_KEY | groq/llama3-70b-8192 |
| xAI | XAI_API_KEY | xai/grok-4 |
| Mistral | MISTRAL_API_KEY | mistral/mistral-large-latest |
| Cohere | COHERE_API_KEY | cohere/command-r-plus |
| DeepSeek | DEEPSEEK_API_KEY | deepseek/deepseek-chat |

## Concurrency Settings

- Video-level: MAX_CONCURRENT_VIDEOS (default: 5)
- Chapter-level: DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT_CHAPTERS (default: 3)
- YouTube requests: YOUTUBE_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE (default: 10)

## Implementation Reference

For implementation-level confirmation:
- `src/notewise/cli/app.py` - CLI command definitions
- `src/notewise/pipeline/core.py` - Pipeline orchestration
- `src/notewise/pipeline/_execution.py` - Execution logic
- `src/notewise/youtube/transcript.py` - Transcript fetching
- `src/notewise/llm/provider.py` - LLM provider wrapper
- `src/notewise/storage/repository.py` - SQLite operations
- `src/notewise/config.py` - Configuration handling
